country.evidence_quote: Stanisław Moniuszko Academy of Music in Gdańsk – aMuz is one of the most important music higher education institution in Poland. In its more than 70-years of history, its overarching goal has been to ensure the highest possible level of education. In recent years, the development of the institution through modernisation and internationalisation has been one of the main priorities in the activities of the Academy.
